name: Dead Hotel
desc:
First the fog came, then the zombies followed. Trapped in a hotel, your only hope for survival is to reach the roof for evacuation. You and your allies must take the elevator and fight through dangerous floors of zombies.

Hotfix: If auto detection fails, you can manually set your device in the lobby.
Previously called 99 Floors of the Dead Hotel

Inspired by 99 Nights, Dead Rails, and Zombie Tower (the one from 10 years ago)
